title: The Bleeding Ground
text: The grass is red and wet, and the earth is warm underfoot, and it gives a little, like flesh. Something died here, something very big, a long time ago. It is still dying. You can feel the slow beat of it through your boots.

options.label: The strongest digs down to whatever lies beneath.

outcomes.text: A heart, vast and slow, still beating in the dirt, worth a fortune. The ground moans as it comes free.
It is still alive, a little, and it does not want to be dug up.

options.label: Cross quickly, and don't look down.

outcomes.text: Red to the knees, and the warmth stays on your skin all day.

options.label: The wisest says the rites for the dying thing.

outcomes.text: The ground cools under your feet, and the slow beat fades, and stops.
